signals.title: Children's Scooter Race at Freedom Island Park
signals.location: Freedom Island Park (Парк-остров "Свобода"), Pazardzhik (~35 min drive)
signals.reason: Hosted at the family's beloved island park, this fun outdoor scooter run gives a 4-year-old great outdoor fun alongside the park's mini zoo and playgrounds.
signals.note: Confirmed on pazardzhik.bg and marica.bg for October 10, 2026.

signals.title: Clever Peter (Хитър Петър) Puppet Show
signals.reason: Delightful folkloric puppet performance filled with lighthearted trickster humor and engaging staging, perfectly timed for preschoolers.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and grabo.bg for October 11, 2026.

signals.title: Parade of Nations & Culture Festival
signals.location: Kamenitsa Stairs to City Garden (Градска градина), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Vibrant multicultural parade with national costumes, music, and food tastings in the shady central park, offering a fun daytime stroll.
signals.note: Could not find a corroborating source confirming this festival on October 10, 2026.

signals.title: Gourmet under the Hills 2026 (Гурмето под тепето)
signals.reason: An outdoor autumn food and craft fair right by their neighbourhood, featuring local honey, waffles, and dedicated healthy eating activities for kids.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and marica.bg for October 9–11, 2026.

signals.title: Camping & Caravaning Expo Plovdiv
signals.reason: Open-air camper van and outdoor gear expo set along the wide, traffic-free paths of the Rowing Canal where preschoolers can scoot and explore freely.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and expo.camping.bg for October 10–11, 2026.

signals.title: Live Dinosaurs – In Search of the Egg (Живи Динозаври)
signals.reason: Interactive family stage production featuring life-sized animatronic dinosaurs, ideal for an exciting afternoon outing with a 4-year-old.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and visitplovdiv.com for October 18, 2026.

signals.title: Peter Rabbit (Зайчето Питър) Guest Puppet Show
signals.reason: Charming Beatrix Potter tale performed by the visiting Stara Zagora puppet troupe, offering gentle morning storytelling tailored to young children.
signals.note: Confirmed on pptheatre.com and how2plovdiv.com for October 25, 2026.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: A massive open-air field with dozens of real airplanes and helicopters where little kids can roam freely and marvel at real aircraft up close.

signals.title: Damascena Biopark & Rose Gardens
signals.reason: A beautifully landscaped botanical park featuring gentle flat paths, wooden bridges, playground corners, and free-roaming swans and deer.

signals.title: English Stand-Up: Mustafa Algiyadi – 'Your Finest Second Cheapest Wine Please'
signals.location: The Comedy Club Plovdiv, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Solo English-language comedy hour by an international touring comic exploring modern social dynamics; squarely matches the English stand-up archetype.
signals.note: Confirmed on comedyclub.bg and fienta.com for October 17, 2026.

signals.title: Disco Music Fest: Back to the '80s & '90s
signals.reason: Live arena concert with international Eurodance and 90s dance icons including C+C Music Factory and Cappella; all performances in English.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and kolodrumplovdiv.com for October 9–10, 2026.

signals.title: Plovdiv Jazz Fest 2026 (Autumn Edition)
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Top-tier international jazz festival featuring Aaron Parks, Shai Maestro, and a Miles Davis centenary tribute; high cultural alignment and entirely non-verbal.
signals.note: Confirmed on eventim.bg and visitplovdiv.com for November 6–8, 2026.

signals.title: Exhibition: 'Design from Plovdiv' (135 Years of Graphic Design)
signals.location: DPH Gallery, 153 Tsar Boris III Obedinitel Blvd, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Curated survey of posters, logotypes, and historical print graphics from Plovdiv; visual format is broadly accessible with minimal text needed.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and podtepeto.com for October 9–29, 2026.

signals.title: Nedko Itinov Retrospective: 'A World of Colour and Light'
signals.location: Plovdiv City Art Gallery, 15 Knyaz Aleksandar I St, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major retrospective of the lyrical Plovdiv painter on the main pedestrian street; visual arts require zero Bulgarian language comprehension.
signals.note: Confirmed on visitplovdiv.com and bta.bg for October 9–28, 2026.

signals.title: Traffic Closure and Pedestrian Expansion on Dr. G. M. Dimitrov Street
signals.location: Dr. G. M. Dimitrov St & Central Square area, Central Plovdiv
signals.reason: Key downtown thoroughfare and parking sector near Central Square closed for municipal underground reconstruction and pedestrianization works.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdiv.bg and marica.bg on October 5, 2026.

signals.title: Old Town Cobblestone Reconstruction on Dr. Stoyan Chomakov Street
signals.location: Dr. Stoyan Chomakov St (Nebet Tepe approach), Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major cobblestone paving and pedestrian pathway repair directly affects the primary access route to Nebet Tepe and adjacent residential zones.
signals.note: Confirmed on marica.bg and citybuild.bg as an ongoing Old Town paving project.

signals.title: Flat-Rate All-Week Ticket Pricing (€5) Introduced at Cinema City Mall Plovdiv
signals.reason: Cinema City has lowered standard screening admission to a daily flat rate of ~€5 (9.78 BGN), making original-language subtitled screenings substantially cheaper.
signals.note: Confirmed on mallplovdiv.bg and Cinema City Bulgaria through October 31, 2026.

signals.title: Launch of Integrated 24/7 Traffic and Toll Camera Enforcement System
signals.location: Plovdiv municipal road network and arterial access roads
signals.reason: Integration of municipal CCTV, police monitors, and national toll camera networks into a single automated 24/7 speed and traffic surveillance grid across Plovdiv.
signals.note: Confirmed on plovdivdaily.bg and trafficnews.bg in October 2026.
